title: Materials Informatics Consultant III
text:
About Citrine Informatics
At Citrine, we’re using Artificial Intelligence (AI)  to enable our customers to usher in the next generation of sustainable, high-performing materials and chemicals.
Our customers love what we do:
“We understand our own laboratory more than before. It’s fun to work in this way.”
We’re the leader in AI for materials and chemicals. 10 of the top 20 chemical companies have trusted us as their AI provider and we have created more than $100 Million dollars in value for our customers to date. Our no-code SaaS platform empowers product developers to accelerate their work using chemically-aware data management and AI tools.
Citrine regularly wins awards for innovation and sustainability, earning spots on the CB Insights AI 100 list and the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies in the US. Our customers include leading organizations such as LyondellBasell, Evonik, Grace, Avery Dennison, and Syensqo. We also collaborate with researchers from world-renowned institutions on cutting-edge research at the intersection of AI and the physical sciences.
Our team is exceptional, eager to grow and learn from each other. Team members work remotely throughout North America and Europe driven by our sustainability mission. We’re growing quickly, and looking for the best to join us!
As a Materials Informatics Consultant, you will work directly with our customers and commercial team to solve challenging problems at the intersection of materials science and machine learning. This role includes regular travel, up to 50%, to customer sites to support the Citrine Platform rollout and adoption, deliver hands-on training, and help customers integrate Citrine into their technical workflows.
About the Role
Citrine is building the future of data and AI in the materials industry. As a Materials Informatics Consultant on the Commercial team, you will work directly with our customers to solve challenging problems at the intersection of materials science and machine learning. You’ll provide outstanding technical support, deployment assistance, and materials informatics training to help customers understand how to use Citrine tools and integrate machine learning into their R&D workflows.
This is a customer-facing technical role that includes regular onsite engagement. You should be excited to travel to customer sites, up to 50%, to support Citrine deployments, lead hands-on enablement sessions, build trusted relationships with technical users, and help customers accelerate adoption of the Citrine Platform.
Responsibilities
- Assisting Citrine Platform users with materials informatics challenges to accelerate product development at materials, chemicals, and manufacturing companies
- Supporting Citrine Platform deployments through a combination of remote collaboration and onsite customer engagement
- Traveling to customer sites, up to 50%, to deliver hands-on deployment support, workflow guidance, technical enablement, and user training
- Developing and supporting customer’s AI assets, such as AI models, on the Citrine Platform in collaboration with Citrine Commercial team members
- Frequent and empathetic communication with customers to provide unparalleled, domain-aware materials informatics support
- Handling incoming support requests from Citrine Platform users, including reporting and reproducing Citrine Platform bugs and feature requests
- Providing data formatting and data ingestion guidance to Citrine Platform users
- Cleaning, structuring, and exploring materials informatics data
- Creating knowledge base content, such as articles, that extends Citrine’s library of user-accessible materials informatics content and addresses frequently asked questions from users
- Creating and maintaining training materials to reflect the newest Citrine Platform features
Skills and Experience
- Degree in materials science, chemistry, physics, or a related field
- Enthusiasm for working with customers in the materials industry to drive adoption of the Citrine Platform
- Experience in Consulting, Professional Services, or Customer Success within a SaaS environment, with a proven ability to build strong customer relationships in an enterprise environment
- Enthusiasm for working with cross-functional teams to develop technical and non-technical solutions to customer challenges
- Demonstrated ability to work autonomously to prioritize, manage time effectively, and execute against deadlines
- Exceptional written and oral communication skills
- Willingness and ability to travel customer sites to support Citrine Platform deployments, onsite training, and customer adoption activities (expected to be around 50%)
Nice-to-Haves
- Experience or coursework in machine learning and/or statistics
- Teaching experience
- Located in Germany
Equal Opportunity
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, or national origin.  Please let us know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.
Accommodations
Citrine is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email us at [email removed] or inform your recruiter if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Interview Process, Security, and AI Use
Citrine is committed to a fair, secure, and transparent hiring process. Depending on the role, our interview process may include live video interviews, technical or skills-based assessments, and reasonable verification steps designed to protect candidates and our company from fraud, impersonation, and other security risks.
We may also use technology tools, including AI-enabled tools, to support parts of the hiring process such as scheduling, note organization, fraud detection, and assessment administration. These tools are used to assist our team and are not the sole basis for employment decisions. Human reviewers remain responsible for evaluating candidates and making hiring decisions.
In some cases, and where legally permitted, we may ask for your consent to record an interview for hiring, quality, security, and interviewer training purposes. We will provide notice in advance when recording is planned and will handle recordings and related interview data in accordance with applicable law and our privacy and retention practices.
For more information on acceptable candidate use of AI tools in our interview process, please see Citrine’s Philosophy on AI Usage in Interviews .
Our Core Values
Citrine Informatics recognizes that its most valuable asset is its people. We have created our set of Core Values to encourage, support, and invest in our team as they work to innovate and support a more sustainable world. Our Core Values reflect our ongoing commitment to continuously invest in nurturing our talent and our people-first approach to conducting business.
- We take pride in and recognize the successes and growth of ourselves and our colleagues. We support each other in our  growth .
- We prototype and collect data to make good decisions. We question that  data  and are constantly iterating to find the best solution.
- We are all  owners  of Citrine and make decisions like owners. We work autonomously with personal and organizational accountability.
- We commit to building a diverse and  inclusive  community within Citrine and actively promote equity and belonging.
- We are tirelessly committed to creating value for our  customers .
- We exist to help our customers accelerate the development of  sustainable  products that are critical to the future of both our planet and our industry.
Compensation and Pay Transparency
At Citrine, we want your path to career growth to be transparent, straightforward, fair, and easily accessible -- starting with your application and interview process. The annual salary range listed below reflects the level we are considering for this position (please note that there may be unique situations where you may fall outside of this range). Where you fall within the range will depend on how your experience and skills align with our internal leveling system as we learn more about you throughout the interview process.
€70,000 - €100,000 EURO

About the Role
Data & AI Research Engineering (DARE) is a uniquely interdisciplinary team working at the intersection of materials science, machine learning, and software engineering. We are responsible for researching, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining the core materials-aware machine learning functionality that powers the Citrine Platform. We collaborate extensively across the company — other teams rely on us throughout the product lifecycle to translate ideas to math to code and back again.
Example projects:
- Improve and maintain our core Python libraries that enable our users to apply machine learning to solve the world’s most important materials science problems at an industrial scale
- Collaborate with our Product team to shape the future of our AI capabilities and support our customer’s unique use cases
- Improve the interpretability of machine learning models and develop tools to communicate that information to users
- Improve our inverse design capabilities that efficiently explore complex parameter spaces that characterize real-world materials synthesis problems
- Collaborate with our External Research and Development (ERD) team to write and publish papers related to the work we’re doing
- Develop new methods to quantify uncertainty in machine learning predictions
Responsibilities
- Writing and maintaining Python ML code
- Researching, prototyping, and developing new materials-aware ML models and features
- Collaborating closely with other engineers, frequently reviewing code and best practices
- Mentoring other developers
- Designing high-performance, scalable ML systems
- Testing & analyzing the impact and performance of models
- Working in a multi-functional team on features from concept to delivery
Skills and Experience
- 8+ years of professional experience or 3+ years with MS/PhD in a quantitative discipline
- Proficient in a programming language such as Python or Scala
- Proven history of implementing AI solutions for customers, with quantifiable results
- Experience solving scientific problems with computational techniques
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and design choices to any audience
- In depth knowledge of how core ML algorithms work and their design (random forest, neural networks, etc.)
- Ability to write tested, production-quality code
- Legally eligible to work in the United States
Preferred Skills and Experience
- Experience with or a degree in Materials Science
- Extensive knowledge of statistics
- Experience with LLMs
-
- Bonus points if you’ve pre-trained or fine-tuned foundation models!
- SQL and relational databases
- Close integration with various AWS services (S3, RDS, SQS, etc)
- Published papers that establish you as a domain expert in AI/ML, NLP, or CV

About the Role
Citrine is hiring a Manager, Business Operations Level 3 to report to our COO. You will manage our Commercial Operations Team, which is responsible for our commercial team tech stack, commission planning, and deal desk. You will own the performance of that function.
You will also lead high-impact analytical work behind our growth – taking on the questions leadership needs answered, doing the analysis, and driving the resulting initiatives through to an outcome.
Responsibilities
Lead the commercial operations function
- Manage, develop, and grow our Commercial Operations Lead — setting priorities, raising the bar on execution quality, and creating room for them to take on more
- Own the health of our revenue systems and the data inside them; make our CRM a source of truth the sales team actually trusts
- Ensure sales compensation and commission calculations are accurate, on time, and clearly explained to the reps they affect
- Own deal desk as a capability, not a queue: build the approval frameworks, discount guardrails, and order-form standards that let deals move quickly without creating downstream problems
Pipeline and forecast analytics
- Own the forecast process end to end — the cadence, the inputs, the model, and the accuracy of the number we commit to
- Build and maintain pipeline, conversion, and sales productivity analytics; find where the funnel actually leaks and quantify what fixing it is worth
- Run rigorous win/loss and churn analysis, and turn the findings into changes in how we sell
- Design the dashboards and metric definitions that let the leadership team see the business without asking for a pull
Pricing and packaging
- Analyze pricing, packaging, and discounting performance across our customer base; surface where we are leaving value on the table and where we are creating friction
- Build the models that support pricing and packaging decisions, including scenario analysis on revenue and margin impact
- Partner with Sales, Product, and Finance to design and test changes to how we monetize the platform
- Establish and steward discount governance so pricing integrity holds as we scale
Growth initiatives
- Lead cross-functional, growth-focused initiatives from problem framing through to implemented outcome — segmentation and ICP definition, territory and coverage design, expansion and land-and-expand motions, funnel experiments
- Bring structure to ambiguous strategic questions: scope the problem, source the data, form a defensible recommendation, and get buy-in to act on it
- Support annual and quarterly GTM planning, including capacity modeling, quota setting, and goal architecture
- Identify operational inefficiencies across the commercial organization and drive the process and tooling changes that resolve them
Board and investor reporting
- Partner with the COO and CFO to produce the metrics package for board meetings and investor updates
- Own the definitions, data lineage, and consistency of our reported KPIs so the numbers hold up under scrutiny
- Build the executive narrative around the data — not just what happened, but what it means and what we should do about it
- Support diligence and reporting requirements for financing and strategic processes as they arise
Skills and Experience
- 5–8 years of experience in management consulting, business operations, revenue operations, or strategy & operations — including time inside a software company
- Demonstrated people management experience: you have managed at least one direct report and can speak specifically to how you developed them
- Track record of owning an ambiguous analytical problem end to end — framing it, doing the work, and driving the resulting change to completion
- Expert-level financial and operational modeling in Excel or Google Sheets; you can build a model someone else can audit
- Working fluency with a CRM (Salesforce or equivalent) and a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, or similar); comfortable reasoning about how GTM data is structured
- Command of core SaaS and GTM metrics — ARR, NRR/GRR, pipeline coverage, CAC payback, LTV:CAC, win rate, sales cycle, magic number
- Executive presence: you can present to a COO, a CEO, or a board and be met as a peer rather than a presenter
- Superb written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complexity into clarity
- High degree of autonomy and self-management — essential in a remote-first company
- Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools, and a habit of using them to compress analytical and operational work
- Desire for a steep learning curve in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
- Legally eligible to work in the United States
Preferred Skills and Experience
- Located in US Eastern Time zone
- Experience at a startup or high-growth company, particularly one where you built a function rather than inherited one
- Enterprise B2B experience — long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with six- and seven-figure contracts
- Prior experience at a top-tier management or strategy consulting firm
- SQL proficiency and comfort querying a data warehouse directly
- Hands-on experience with sales compensation design and commission administration
- Experience supporting board and investor reporting at a venture-backed company
- Exposure to CPQ, quote-to-cash, or revenue recognition processes
- Interest in materials science, chemistry, manufacturing, or deep-tech markets — you do not need a technical background, but curiosity about what our customers do goes a long way
- MBA or comparable analytical training

- Demonstrated experience managing complex, technical projects and teams to outstanding results
